## Foods & dishes
[[RecipeDB2]] ≈40 (v1, mislabelled region Middle Eastern); [[Food.com Recipes and Interactions]] 16; [[WorldCuisines]] 14 dishes (3 Laos-only); [[FmLAMA]] 6; [[World Wide Dishes]] 1.

## Ingredients & food composition
No FCT; [[ASEAN Food Composition Database]] (candidate, priority 2) is the regional fallback.

## Compounds & traditional medicine
[[CMAUP]] 228 plants; [[Dr. Duke's Phytochemical and Ethnobotanical Databases|Duke]] 3 records; [[KNApSAcK Family]] flag page not scraped. Global resources without country labels (FooDB, SpiceRx, FlavorDB2, Phenol-Explorer, CTD, HMDB, FoodAtlas, FooDrugs) apply via [[Global]].

## Gaps
No FCT, no Lao-language data, no traditional-medicine source.
